name: Nassau Paper Company Ltd
brand_truth: One counter on Carib Road for everything a Nassau business uses up: disposables, janitorial, paper and print.

design.signature: R3F counter still life of their departments with clickable department tags; quote builder with case steppers

current_site_findings: The online store has 100+ pages of products but no one-line statement of what, where and when for a first-time visitor.
Hours and the Carib Road address are mainly in directory listings.
Printing (Napco Printing Service) lives on a separate Facebook page.
Page titles carry no search words such as 'janitorial supplies Nassau'.
The site refused our preview tools ('Forbidden') on every attempt: worth checking link previews and visitor access.
pitch_line: You have hundreds of products online, but a new restaurant owner can't tell in five seconds that you're the one counter for cups, cleaning supplies, paper and print; this concept says it on the first screen and turns a shopping list into a quote request.
assumptions: Quote-builder example items are category-standard (plates and bowls, takeaway containers, toilet tissue, cleaning chemicals; print items business cards, flyers, letterhead, forms, menus, signage)
Delivery only offered as 'Ask about delivery'
notes: nassaupaperco.com returned 403 to Firecrawl twice and Facebook is unsupported, so facts come from search snippets of their own pages, Facebook snippets and BahamasLocal. No photos: 3D still life uses generic forms, no brand marks. platform.candidate true (supply merchant already selling online). Remaining QA warning: small 3D tags on mobile. interact.mjs is very slow on this page (WebGL in software rendering).
